meaning:
βοηθός, -ον (see: βοηθέω),
[in LXX chiefly for עזר ;]
1. (poët. -όος), hasting to the war-cry (Hom.).
2. helping, auxiliary; as subst. (Hdt.), a helper: Heb.13:6 (LXX).
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
